str_consts:
2026-08-04: the refusal was right, the MASK it audited was wrong.

    ``assign_basins`` used to build ``water_mask = isfinite(dem) & (dem <
    water_level)`` — a flat threshold with NO connectivity condition — and then
    refuse every seedless component of it.  On the real three-basin frame that is
    179 components, so no three-basin frame rendered at all.

    But a pit below some basin's level that no water can reach FROM that basin is
    not that basin's water; it is a pit.  ``water_mask`` is now the union of the
    4-connected components of ``{dem < water_level}`` that hold a basin seed, so a
    seedless body is not water and never has to be refused.  These tests pin the
    consequence in both corridor modes, on the same two fixtures that used to pin
    the refusal, and the class below pins that the refusal itself still raises.
